purpose: Retain the required original green double-leaf sprout hairstyle across three healer designs.

records.label: A 芽型·药匣
records.prompt:
Head/hairstyle identity harmonization of a healer design. IMAGE1 supplies the costume, medicinal prop and standing composition to keep. IMAGE2 supplies the REQUIRED GREEN SPROUT HAIRSTYLE: rounded leaf-green bob with chunky fringe, exactly TWO LARGE leaf-shaped sprout forms growing from the top of the hair (one upward, one angled outward), two longer leaf-shaped side locks tied with simple white round pom-poms. Make these part of the character's hair silhouette, not a small plant stuck onto an unrelated bun.
Replace image1's entire old hair design and hair accessories with image2's sprout hairstyle; remove old flower/bun/headband entirely. Harmonize the face into a gentle friendly youthful cartoon healer with violet eyes and compact project proportions, fully wholesome. Preserve image1's distinct clothing tailoring and medicine prop, original pose and head/body size as closely as possible. All outfits stay fully opaque, no sexualized anatomy or pose.
Keep the new leafy green hair as the COMMON recognizable identity. Slightly harmonize clothing accent colors with the green hair if needed while retaining the distinct variant palette and design. Project gem-icon finish: bold controlled dark contour, few broad matte color/value planes, no noisy tiny facets, glitter or realistic texture. Both feet planted, front three-quarter left standing, correct hands holding props. Full leaves/prop/boots inside square plain warm ivory, no text, panels, scenery or added items. VARIANT A: keep the ivory/dusty-rose petal shoulder cape, plum sash, long layered ivory/rose skirt, low shoes and round medicine case cradled in both hands from image1. Replace white bob and peony ornament completely with the green sprout hair from image2. Keep flower motifs sparse and broad. New head must connect naturally to the original neck, both upper sprout leaves entirely in frame.
